title: Dynamics & Headroom
summary: A focused workspace for loudness movement, peak safety, and programme dynamics.
descriptionMarkdown: Review loudness movement and programme structure on a shared 60-second timeline, then compare Peak and RMS level behaviour side by side. Dynamics Summary keeps Integrated, True Peak Max, Loudness Range, PLR, PSR, Momentary Max, and Short-term Max visible without unrelated metrics. The Preset keeps Loudness Profile and Dock off, so it supports analysis without implying a delivery standard.
